segments.name: Triple-net leasing
segments.description: Leases skilled nursing, assisted living and long-term acute care properties to healthcare operators on triple-net terms.
segments.evidence: We conduct and manage our business as one operating segment for internal reporting and internal decision-making purposes.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under long-term triple-net leases for healthcare properties the company owns.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate substantially all of our revenues by leasing our properties to tenants under long-term leases primarily on a triple-net basis, under which the tenant pays the cost of real estate taxes, insurance and other operating costs of the facility and capital expenditures.
